title: Zoo Manners
description: NCERT Class 2 English (Marigold): 'Zoo Manners'. New words, comprehension, asking questions, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Zoo Manners': zoo, animal, polite, cage.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Zoo Manners' mean (zoo, animal, polite, cage); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: We see lions and tigers at the ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A word that means well-behaved is ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: What time does the zoo open?

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Zoo Manners' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Zoo Manners'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem teaches us to be ___ at the zoo.
At the zoo, we must be gentle and ___ to the animals.

exemplars: What time does the zoo open?

nodes.title: Asking Questions
nodes.teach_focus: A question starts with a question word (what/where/who) and ends with '?'.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses asking questions correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of asking questions.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which one is a correct question?

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Zoo Manners'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Zoo Manners': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: At the zoo, I want to see a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: What time does the zoo open?

items.prompt: A word that means well-behaved is ___.
We see lions and tigers at the ___.
The poem teaches us to be ___ at the zoo.
At the zoo, we must be gentle and ___ to the animals.
Which one is a correct question?
